bottleneck.summary: Choose C15 state with no negative finite-path entries; retain P-3m1 sibling with eight negative entries as grade2. C15 control has small but ten-sign-consistent Re-to-Tc EPC benefit and positive sampled phonon evidence.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Source coarse/fine pressure/fullstress/force andpositiveopticalGamma plus finite-path/q evidence; exacttested domain only. No laboratory P/T/hull/globalstability inheritance.
